_README: Requirements to DECLARE the Computer Science major (SAS, New Brunswick), quoted from the official pages. Phase 7.6.

Every `quote` is verbatim from the archived page named by its source (data/raw/..., gitignored local evidence; sha256 prefixes below). Nothing is paraphrased into a rule that the sources do not state.
The two sources disagree on students with transfer or equivalent credit (two courses vs three). Both are shown and the disagreement is recorded under `conflicts`; CoursePilot does not pick one.
Neither source states a GPA minimum, a separate rule for the B.S., or how many times a course may be repeated for declaration. None is added.
Applies to both CS degree options: the department page and the catalog state one set of entry requirements for the major.

sources.title: Rutgers Department of Computer Science - Admission to the Major
Rutgers-New Brunswick Undergraduate Catalog 2026-2027, Computer Science 198 - Entry Requirements for the Major

quotes.quote: Students wishing to declare a major in computer science must achieve a grade of C or better in the following 5 courses:
Students wishing to declare a major in computer science must achieve a grade of C or better in 01:198:111, 112, and 205, and 01:640:151-152.

requirements.text: Students with credit for courses equivalent to 01:198:111, 112 or 205 must complete at least two courses in the New Brunswick Department of Computer Science (01:198:xxx) before being admitted to the major.

quotes.quote: Students who have received credit for courses equivalent to 01:198:111,112, or 205 must complete at least two (2) courses in the New Brunswick Department of Computer Science (01:198:xxx) before being admitted to the major.

requirements.text: Transfer students must take at least three courses in the Rutgers-New Brunswick Department of Computer Science before being accepted to the major.

quotes.quote: Transfer students are required to take at least three courses in the Rutgers University-New Brunswick Department of Computer Science before being accepted to the major.

requirements.text: An SAS student who meets these requirements declares the major at mymajor.sas.rutgers.edu.

conflicts: The department page says students with credit for courses equivalent to 01:198:111, 112 or 205 need two courses in the New Brunswick CS department before admission; the 2026-2027 catalog says transfer students need three. CoursePilot shows both; confirm with the department.
